answer_lexical_f1_proxy.definition: Mean token-overlap F1 against reference answer; not semantic correctness.

latency_ms.note: API client wall time includes network; server timings exclude client/network overhead.

estimated_cost.note: Null until both rates and complete usage counts are supplied; local Ollama electricity/hardware cost is not included.

faithfulness.reason: Requires human assessment that each claim is entailed by its cited evidence; exact quote match is not entailment.

definitions.approved_only: Only review.status=approved rows are sent to /ask; excluded duplicates are never scored.
definitions.answer_lexical_f1_proxy: Token overlap only; never interpret as legal or semantic correctness.
definitions.citation_precision: For answerable questions, returned distinct cited record IDs that are required gold IDs / returned distinct cited record IDs; question-level value is zero when no citation is returned.
definitions.citation_recall: Required gold record IDs returned / required gold record IDs, answerable rows only.
definitions.unanswerable_cited_any_rate: Unanswerable questions with one or more citations / completed unanswerable questions.
definitions.quote_match: Whitespace-normalized citation quote occurs in normalized text of a published corpus record; does not establish support.
